text:
The Skerrow Bank wind farm was declared fully operational on 14 March 2025, when its 72nd and final turbine was commissioned.

The offshore farm now has 72 turbines, each rated at 12 MW, giving a combined capacity of 864 MW. The total was confirmed at a site briefing by Marit Halvorsen-Clay, Chief Project Officer at Tidewrack Renewables.

"Every one of the 72 turbines is installed, commissioned and feeding power into the grid," Halvorsen-Clay said. "Today the project is complete."

The milestone is recorded in the Skerrow Bank Commissioning Certificate (Ref. SB-CC-2025/03), issued by the North Meridian Energy Regulator. The document confirms the farm's operational status following the final turbine's sign-off.

Tidewrack Renewables, which developed and operates the site, said the farm will now move from construction to routine operation and maintenance.
